**Platform:** Windows 10/11 (64-bit)

Extract the zip and run **Weave.exe** as administrator (right-click > Run as administrator). Accept the UAC prompt.

Choose **Install MayaFlux** to download the framework and install dependencies (CMake, Git, Ninja, LLVM, FFmpeg, Vulkan SDK via winget), or **Create Project** if MayaFlux is already installed.

There is no CLI tool on Windows. All operations go through the GUI.

See [docs/WINDOWS.md](https://github.com/MayaFlux/Weave/blob/main/docs/WINDOWS.md) for full details.
